gates.name: Reference intake
gates.findings: Reference inspected, traced; tools/rights and assumptions documented. Independent acceptance unavailable.

gates.name: Blockout
gates.findings: Actual front/profile/back/three-quarter renders reveal fused garment, featureless face, approximate head/crown, missing hair separation, armor and coat openings. Silhouette only.

gates.name: Anatomy
gates.findings: No licensed credible anatomical mesh or Blender. Do not substitute primitive geometry.

gates.name: Garments
gates.findings: Separate garment layers, folds and fit not modeled.

gates.name: Retopology
gates.findings: Voxel triangulation is not deformation-ready retopology.

gates.name: Baking
gates.findings: No high-to-low normal or AO bake.

gates.name: Production rig
gates.findings: A separate inferred diagnostic skeleton with four-weight skinning and one 2-second test clip is included in the G1 proxy; not production rigging.

gates.name: Engine integration
gates.findings: GLB binary diagnostic and geometry reimport passed; Three.js viewer source exists, runtime device and Khronos validation not run.

gates.name: Release
gates.findings: No independent review or production gate seals. Do not promote to AAA/game-ready.
